153:t_1:89.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「What do you intend to do, $$ミネバ$$?」

153:t_1:90.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I'll speak with $$マーサ・ビスト・カーバイン$$ and determine her true intentions.」

153:t_1:94.en: ～$$オーブ連合首長国$$　Chief Representative's Residence　Conference Room～

153:t_1:95.en:
$$カガリ$$
「...I see. Then bring her here.」

153:t_1:96.en:
$$マーサ$$
「What did $$ミネバ・ザビ$$ say?」

153:t_1:97.en:
$$カガリ$$
「She says she'll meet you. I respect her wishes.」

153:t_1:98.en:
$$マーサ$$
「What...! $$オーブ$$ has been sheltering $$ミネバ・ザビ$$, the orphaned child of the $$ザビ家$$!?」

153:t_1:100.en:
$$マーサ$$
「This... is a grave betrayal of the $$地球連邦$$! It cannot be tolerated!」

153:t_1:101.en:
$$マーサ$$
「As a private citizen, I will report this to the military!」

153:t_1:102.en:
$$カガリ$$
「$$マーサ・ビスト・カーバイン$$...!」

153:t_1:103.en:
$$マーサ$$
「I suggest you make no rash moves, Representative. My people have already infiltrated this residence.」

153:t_1:104.en:
$$カガリ$$
「Your aim from the start was to abduct $$ミネバ$$ and crush $$オーブ$$!」

153:t_1:105.en:
$$マーサ$$
「If you quietly hand over that $$ジオン$$ girl, I have no intention of treating you roughly. I leave such matters to the military.」

153:t_1:106.en:
$$マーサ$$
「But $$オーブ$$'s existence will only obstruct future relations between Earth and the Empire. Accordingly, we will take appropriate measures.」

153:t_1:108.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Representative $$アスハ$$... It seems you've been poisoned by men's logic.」

153:t_1:109.en:
$$マーサ$$
「People cannot live on ideals and pride. I'll make you understand that, too.」

153:t_1:113.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Secure $$ミネバ・ザビ$$ with $$アルベルト$$.」

153:t_2:4.en:
$$マーサ$$
「I'm glad to see you looking well, Your Highness $$ミネバ$$. Allow me to greet you once more on our reunion.」

153:t_2:6.en:
$$マーサ$$
「How were your days in $$オーブ$$? Did they serve as a brief vacation?」

153:t_2:7.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Heh heh... $$オードリー・バーン$$... Even for an alias, it has a lovely ring.」

153:t_2:8.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「...Did Chairman $$ローナン・マーセナス$$ also approve this attack on $$オーブ$$?」

153:t_2:9.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Of course. Chairman $$ローナン$$ and I are working toward the same goal.」

153:t_2:11.en:
$$マーサ$$
「We will seal away $$ラプラスの箱$$. I understand you left $$ネオ・ジオン$$ because you wished for that as well, Your Highness.」

153:t_2:12.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Are you saying you've found the Box's location?」

153:t_2:13.en:
$$マーサ$$
「No... But we do know what its key is.」

153:t_2:15.en:
$$マーサ$$
「We will obtain the $$ユニコーン$$ soon enough. Until then, its young pilot will act as its keeper.」

153:t_2:16.en:
$$マーサ$$
「You're acquainted with him as well, Your Highness. $$バナージ・リンクス$$.」

153:t_2:18.en:
$$マーサ$$
「We also know that the $$ラプラス・プログラム$$, which indicates the Box's location, was last revealed in $$ダカール$$.」

153:t_2:19.en:
$$マーサ$$
「We intend to acquire the $$ユニコーン$$ and, at the same time, get the next set of coordinates out of $$バナージ・リンクス$$.」

153:t_2:20.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I cannot imagine that boy agreeing to such a scheme.」

153:t_2:21.en:
$$マーサ$$
「$$バナージ・リンクス$$... He's inherited the blood of the $$ビスト家$$'s men only in ways like that...」

153:t_2:23.en:
$$マーサ$$
「That boy's father is $$カーディアス・ビスト$$, my elder brother.」

153:t_2:24.en:
$$マーサ$$
「His mistress's child has inherited his foolish father's delusions... You have no idea how much trouble it's caused us...」

153:t_2:25.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$バナージ$$ is... that man's...」

153:t_2:26.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Would you join forces with me, Your Highness $$ミネバ$$?」

153:t_2:27.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「You want me to persuade $$バナージ$$?」

153:t_2:28.en:
$$マーサ$$
「I'll treat you well. With you as an intermediary, we could improve relations with $$ネオ・ジオン$$ as well.」

153:t_2:29.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Then first, I want you to return $$マリーダ・クルス$$ to us.」

153:t_2:30.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Lieutenant $$マリーダ$$... $$プロト・プルトゥエルブ$$ is working under us of her own free will.」

153:t_2:32.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Yes, we did. Just as $$ネオ・ジオン$$... no, $$ジオン$$ did.」

153:t_2:33.en:
$$マーサ$$
「We weren't the ones who created that pitiful creature.」

153:t_2:35.en:
$$マーサ$$
「I merely released what lay within her and gave her a chance for revenge.」

153:t_2:37.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Yes. She wants revenge against the world that created something like her, a world ruled by men's logic...」

153:t_2:39.en:
$$マーサ$$
「$c will soon arrive in $$オーブ$$ as well.」

153:t_2:40.en:
$$マーサ$$
「I'll have her do her work there.」

153:t_3:4.en:
$$リディ$$
「Come with me, $$ミネバ$$! I've come to save you!」

153:t_3:6.en:
$$リディ$$
「Get into the $$デルタプラス$$, quickly!」

153:t_3:7.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$, do you understand your position?」

153:t_3:8.en:
$$リディ$$
「I'm doing this because I understand it! You know what would happen if you killed $$ローナン・マーセナス$$'s son, don't you!」

153:t_3:10.en:
$$リディ$$
「What the hell is wrong with you people! You attacked $$オーブ$$ like that and abducted $$ミネバ$$!」

153:t_3:11.en:
$$リディ$$
「Are you planning to cozy up to $$クロノ$$ and wag your tails for $$サイデリアル$$ while you're at it!」

153:t_3:12.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「Custody of the Box is also an internal matter for the $$ビスト家$$! Stay out of another family's affairs!」

153:t_3:13.en:
$$リディ$$
「How can you say that at a time like this...!?」

153:t_3:14.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「$$バナージ・リンクス$$, who guards the key to the Box, is the child my father, former family head $$カーディアス・ビスト$$, had with his mistress.」

153:t_3:15.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$バナージ$$ is... part of the $$ビスト家$$...」

153:t_3:16.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「Even if you are a member and heir of the $$マーセナス家$$, I ask that you stop interfering with us.」

153:t_3:18.en:
$$リディ$$
「...Do whatever you want with the Box, the $$ユニコーン$$, and $$バナージ$$! But you're giving her back!」

153:t_3:19.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「What do you intend to do after taking me away?」

153:t_3:20.en:
$$リディ$$
「We can think about that once we're out of here!」

153:t_3:21.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「What do you want to protect? Me as a person, or the secret of $$ラプラスの箱$$? Or your family's honor...」
